native/src/iw4_view_kick.cpp is a modified C++ adaptation of the view component
of weapon_fire_recoil, kick_angles_step_axis and kick_angles. The M9 controller
supplies the source weapon values and a confirmed native-shot receipt.
Adaptation changes: bounded input validation, M9-only/no-perk interface, C++ state
storage. The source implementation is a rewrite reference, not a claim that
these native DSR callbacks have been exercised or that all retail IW4 behavior
has been independently verified.

No Bevy renderer, Minecraft/Skate code, fonts or other components of the fork are
included. No game assets are distributed. Native DSR projectile collision and
damage remain the target backend; this component computes view angles only.
